project_type: Roblox Luau game (Pet Simulator) with Python build tool
language: Lua (Luau dialect) for game code, Python for build tool
build_system: python tools/generate_rbxlx.py from project root - reads all .lua files in src/ and generates BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx
test_framework: No automated tests. Validation is: (1) python build generates valid XML, (2) xmllint --noout passes on .rbxlx
test_command: python -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('XML valid')"
verification_instructions: 1. Run python tools/generate_rbxlx.py - must succeed. 2. Validate XML with python xml parser. 3. Confirm all new .lua files are referenced in generate_rbxlx.py (service_names or controller_names or module_names). 4. Check git diff to confirm all src/ changes.
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is regenerated by tools/generate_rbxlx.py and checked in. Must be regenerated after any src/ changes.
setup_instructions: Python 3 is pre-installed. No dependencies to install.
environment_constraints: No Roblox Studio available - validation is purely static (XML parse, code review). No runtime testing possible.
contribution_requirements: Work on feature branch. Clear commit messages. Regenerate .rbxlx after all src/ changes. User does NOT use Rojo.
key_patterns: Services are ModuleScript singletons in src/ServerScriptService/Services/. Client controllers are in src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/. Shared data modules in src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/. Main.server.lua creates all Remotes and wires handlers. Main.client.lua connects handlers and manages input.
directory_structure: src/ServerScriptService/Services/ - server modules. src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ - client scripts. src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ - shared config/data modules. tools/ - build tooling. BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx - generated output.
